rag.text:
Test: TC-317 — Box Module - Gantt - Basic operations - WBS
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-52 Box Module - Gantt - Basic operations
Labels: gmodule, teamspace

Steps:
1. Open Gantt module of box with boxName
   Data: boxName: TS-52 Box Module - Gantt
   Expected: Gantt chart is successfully loaded and displayed.

WBS is open on the left side.
2. Click the toggle bar between WBS and the chart
   Expected: WBS closes, with only the toggle bar visible.

The arrow is replaced with TASKS text.

Chart folLows the border so that the leftmost visible day remains next to the toggle bar, revealing more days on the right.
3. Click the toggle bar again
   Expected: WBS opens.

TASKS text is replaced with an arrow pointing to the left.

Chart folLows the border so that the leftmost visible day remains next to the toggle bar, hiding some days on the right.
4. Open Infobar and switch to _Overdue tasks_ tab

Scroll up and down a bit while hovering over WBS
   Expected: Both WBS and chart are scrolled simultaneously.

Infobar is not scrolled.
5. Grab the edge of WBS and move it a bit

Release the edge and check after refresh page
   Expected: Width of WBS is changed.
6. Open Infobar

Grab the edge of WBS and pull it towards the Infobar
   Expected: WBS stops upon reaching the edge of Infobar.
7. Grab the edge of WBS and reduce its width as much as possible

Release the edge and check after refresh
   Expected: WBS cannot be narrower than 96px.

When the edge is released beLow the minimal width, WBS is closed.
8. Reopen WBS
   Expected: WBS does not have the minimal width, instead it is the same as before closing it by dragging to the left.
9. Hover over Summary of taskName on WBS
   Data: taskName: Project plan
   Expected: A tooltip with field's name and value appears.
"Summary (Built-in): Project plan"
10. Grab the edge of the WBS and drag it to the right so the Gantt chart is much more narrower than WBS.
   Expected: Width of WBS is resized.

The Gantt chart is visible but it is much more narrower than WBS.
11. Using text Search next to QF type searchWord
   Data: searchWord: fdsfsadfsfewadsaf
   Expected: There is a splash screen visible saying:
"No tasks matching your filters
You have filters enabled that result in hidden tasks."

Under the text, there is a button: Clear active filters
12. On visible splash screen click button: Clear active filters
   Expected: All filters are cleared.

WBS and Gantt chart are visible.

The width of the WBS is the same as in step 10.
